title: Metacognitive Decoding: Efficient Inference for Diffusion Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.37642v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models offer a promising path to efficient agents through parallel token generation. However, efficient interaction requires adapting both where computation is spent and how much text is generated. We introduce a metacognitive controller that guides diffusion generation according to the needs of the current response and the agent's interaction with the environment. It learns when to finalize tokens and how far generation should extend, reducing overall computation within responses. Our controller, a lightweight plug-in for the diffusion backbone, is trained on agent trajectories to balance correctness and generation cost. This approach connects the agent's generation process to the interaction the agent serves. Experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that our approach reduces inference FLOPs by 20.6% on average compared with the most efficient baseline, while maintaining competitive task accuracy. translated_title: 元认知解码：面向扩散语言智能体的高效推理
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型通过并行token生成为构建高效智能体提供了一条有前景的路径。然而，高效的交互需要同时调整计算资源分配的位置以及生成文本的数量。我们引入了一个元认知控制器，根据当前响应的需求以及智能体与环境的交互情况来引导扩散生成过程。它学习何时确定token以及生成应延伸多远，从而减少响应内的整体计算开销。我们的控制器是扩散骨干网络的一个轻量级插件，通过智能体轨迹进行训练，以平衡正确性与生成成本。该方法将智能体的生成过程与其所服务的交互任务联系起来。在五个基准测试上的实验表明，与最高效的基线方法相比，我们的方法平均减少了20.6%的推理FLOPs，同时保持了具有竞争力的任务准确率。消融实验研究……
tldr: 提出一种轻量级元认知控制器插件，使扩散语言智能体学会何时确定token及生成多长文本，在保持任务准确率的同时平均减少20.6%的推理计算量。
